fieldValues.title: Find
fieldValues.moved_by: every session that resumes work, or has no task: `clerk desk`, then the open sequence it lists, then that sequence's next task free to take, run through `clerk flow --chain`
fieldValues.needs: the desk is current (rewritten on every upkeep run, clerk#203) and shows all active work: each epic's open sequences with the next task free to take, the central lane's queue, and claims with no PR (clerk#204). The desk's Needs you is the owner's queue: an agent never takes an item from it as its next task (it may unblock its own PR listed there) and resumes the first `↳ sequence` row showing `next:`, else the central lane or a group queue (srs-context brief "Resuming work"). Read the vignettes behind the work before acting
fieldValues.theory: Work run in a chat window is lost when the window closes. Work that is in the flow (an issue, placed, in a sequence) is found again from the desk by any session (owner, 2026-10-25). The srs-context brief "Resuming work" points every new session here. From Find, a session resuming a sequence goes to its next task (Claim and build); new work starts at Story.
gaps: The flow keeper, which joins the dots the desk reads, has no schedule yet (clerk#201).
fieldValues.remedies: clerk#203; clerk#204; clerk#201; clerk#112 (a sequence becomes a unit)
fieldValues.evidence: owner, 2026-10-25, verbatim in srs-programme Narrative explorations (note 71d4c10a); clerk#197 run reports; desk staleness, discovery 16
